programme.title: Our Wild Hearts
programme.desc: Willow (Cambrie Schroder), a determined young teenager, is obsessed with the idea of meeting the father she never knew. As the two struggle to bond, Willow makes a connection with a wild mustang, Bravo. Jack wants to capture and tame the magnificent horse, but Willow is convinced he needs to be free. Will the wild stallion that brought them together end up tearing them apart?
